newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PERSETEL VOLUMES BIG ON Q-DATA MOVE.
newsitem.headline: PERSETEL VOLUMES BIG ON Q-DATA MOVE.

text.p: Volumes in South African information technology firm Persetel Holdings Ltd rose sharply on Monday following a late trade deal by brokers Barnad Jacobs Mellet of seven million shares, dealers said.
The total deal was worth over 234 million rand, one dealer at the stockbroking firm said.

But one Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) dealer said the shares had been sold to a local investor amid continued interest on Persetel's move to merge operations with local information technology firm Q-Data.
"I think this (trade) still has to do with the announcement of the merger," the dealer said.
Persetel stock was, however, last down 50 cents at 35.75 rand with total volumes at 261.1 million rand and Q-Data off 10 cents at 990 cents.
The companies said last Thursday Persetel would buy all of Q-Data's businesses and merge with their own.
The merged company, to be called Persetel Q-Data (PQ) Holdings, would have an expected market capitalisation of 12 billion rand, making it the 22nd largest company on the JSE.
